name: Where He is King
source:
It’s all just a game to him, In the world where he is king. 

You’re the last human alive, and the one responsible for the massacre wants to meet with you. Will you gather up the strong will needed to survive? Or… will you succumb like the rest? 

[From [url=https://mellowbile.itch.io/where-he-is-king]itch.io[/url]]
